full_page.content:
SAINT FELIX CAPUCHIN FRIARY HUNTINGTON, IND.
Bles'd be God in all His designs!
God bless you and all yours: Miss Panyard, almost time ... I am trying to get this off today.
Many thanks for your kind favor Rec'd yesterday. Please God I'll remember you at least as often as I use same.
Sincerely yours in Christ, Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Pardon haste .....
